title: F13 · MCP /api/mcp/v1 verifyApiKey + tenant-from-key
goal: Replace the Bearer-prefix-only auth on /api/mcp/v1 with a real verifyApiKey check that resolves the tenant from the verified key, and pass that tenant into tool execution instead of the hardcoded 'bypilar'. initialize/ping remain open (MCP handshake). Suggestion-only; no auto merge/deploy.

acceptanceCriteria.text: tools/list + tools/call require a verified Bearer key (not just a Bearer prefix)
resolveApiKey resolves tenant from the key across all tenants (no tenant in URL)
tools/call executes against the key's tenant (not hardcoded bypilar)
Vitest covers resolve + route; typecheck green
